name: Kentucky 4-H Teen Conference
org: University of Kentucky Cooperative Extension, Kentucky 4-H
what_you_do: A four-day leadership event for Kentucky 4-H teens.
who_can_apply: Kentucky 4-H teens in 8th grade and up (2026 listing). Sign up through your county Extension office.
deadline_text: The 2027 conference is June 1 to 4, 2027. No 2027 sign up date is posted. In 2026, registration closed April 15, 2026.
how_to_apply: Ask your county Extension office how to sign up for 2027. In 2026 you turned in a form to that office by the deadline. You must be in Kentucky 4-H through 4-H Online.
notes: The 2027 page gives only the dates, place and a contact: patrick.allen@uky.edu. Grades, cost and the deadline come from a 2026 county page that is now gone, so confirm them with your county office. The state 4-H page names it but gives no details.
